title: [Workspaces] CrowdStrike Falcon flags Workspace execution as malicious
summary: CrowdStrike Falcon reports a detection when launching a Workspaces shortcut.

judgment.rationale: The scenario requires a discriminating comparison before the failing boundary can be established.
evidence: On PowerToys 0.99.1 the reporter says Falcon flags a Workspace launching Chrome, Outlook, Edge, Fork and Teams.
The report does not include the alert name, detected executable or security-vendor assessment.
Inspected src/modules/workspaces/WorkspacesLauncher/AppLauncher.cpp: LaunchApp uses ShellExecuteEx with open or runas to launch configured application paths; the detected process is unknown.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the focused comparison and avoid claiming a cause or covering fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction or supported behavior investigation may be applicable after resolving the identified uncertainty.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Workspaces security detection
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The alert could concern a legitimate launcher pattern or another process, but neither a false positive nor a PowerToys defect is established.
plan: Identify the detected process and alert classification from the redacted security-vendor evidence.
Coordinate with the organization’s security team and vendor to determine whether it is a false positive or a reproducible launcher problem.
If a PowerToys defect is established, correct the specific launch behavior without weakening security controls.
Add a focused launcher regression test for any confirmed defect.
verification: The confirmed legitimate launch scenario completes without the identified defect.
Security policies and protections remain enabled and elevated launches retain their safeguards.

confidence.rationale: The reported failure boundary and current behavior are not yet established.

comment.body: Thanks for listing the applications and CrowdStrike Falcon. Could you share the Falcon detection name and the detected process/executable name or path, redacting organization-specific information and following your security team’s policies? This will help distinguish a launcher detection from a detection in one of the launched applications. Please do not disable your security protections.
